buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Mandatory Pre-Bid Interaction A pre-bid interaction shall be conducted with prospective bidders to clarify the technical specifications, op erational requirements, scope of supply and other terms and conditions of the bid.

The date, time and venue/mode of the pre-bid interaction shall be notified in the bid document. 2. Document Verification During the pre-bid interaction, bidders may be requested to present their relevant technical documents a nd supporting information for preliminary scrutiny and clarification, including: a. Complete Technical Datasheet of the offered drone. b. OEM Authorization Certificate, wherever applicable. c. Applicable DGCA Type Certificate and other statutory approvals, wherever required. d. Product Brochure and Technical Specifications. e. Warranty and After-Sales Service Details. f. Details of authorized service centres and availability of spare parts. g. Relevant test reports and product certifications, wherever applicable. h. Details of installation, commissioning and training facilities. All mandatory documents required for technical evaluation shall be uploaded on the GeM portal along with the bid. Physical presentation of documents during the pre-bid interaction shall not substitute the mandat ory online submission requirements. 3. Technical Product Demonstration Where permitted under the approved and published procurement policy of the Buyer Organisation, the bid der may be requested to demonstrate the offered drone and its operational capabilities during the pre-bid interaction. The demonstration may cover: a. Basic flight operations and controls. b. Flight endurance and operational performance. c. GPS and navigation capabilities. d. Camera and payload functionality, wherever applicable. e. Remote controller and ground control station functionality. f. Battery performance and charging system. g. Safety features and emergency procedures. The demonstration shall be conducted only for understanding and clarification of the offered product's tec hnical capabilities and shall not be treated as a substitute for the prescribed technical evaluation process. 4. Technical Clarifications The bidders shall clarify all technical queries raised by the Buyer/Technical Evaluation Committee regardin g the offered product. Any clarification or response shall not be allowed to alter the essential technical specifications, eligibility c onditions or commercial terms of the bid. 5. Recording of Pre-Bid Interaction Minutes of the pre-bid interaction, including important queries, clarifications and observations, shall be rec orded by the Buyer Organisation. Any amendment or clarification affecting the bid conditions shall be issued through the appropriate corrige ndum/clarification on the GeM portal so that all prospective bidders receive equal information. SCOPE OF SUPPLY The successful bidder shall supply one complete Drone System along with all essential accessories, compo nents and documentation as mentioned below: Item Description Drone (Complete Unit)| Control Pro Smart Remote Controller (RC)| Battery Pack Charger Propellers| PairsUSB Type-C Cable Protective Drone Carrying Case / Carry Bag User Manual / User Guide .
